## 席位核对 — REWORK (PR body only) · head 58e12ffd08ca58760f623cf9043e1fc9c3c4bcbf

No code change is asked for. The code, measurements and pins hold, as listed below. Two Acceptance-notes lines read as residuals with no carrier.

### To fix (body edit; the head stays 58e12ffd08)

1. **"No guard beyond the source pin keeps `plugin-grid` out of the eager closure; a `check-eager-closure-budget` carve-out … would close that class. Not done here."** This is a stated gap with no `#N`. Either file a card and cite it, or state why none is owed.
   - New gates are "no" by default unless the maintainer names one (the SKILL.md four-axis frame).
   - The class is already watched by `pluginCoreSubpaths-33581` (the source pin, ablation 2) and by the total `check:eager-closure` budget.
2. **"`plugin-detail-core` carries `ConcurrentUpdateDialog` … splitting it is a follow-up candidate, not measured separately."** The same applies: cite a `#N`, or reword it as a measured statement of what the chunk holds, with no "follow-up candidate". Either is fine.

A body edit re-runs the PR-body guards. Tell me when they are green, and I will read the body alone.

### Checked and holding

- **Shape:** `l1-face.mjs --pr 36336` is clean at 58e12ffd08, with 48 success, 11 expected skip, 0 failed and mergeable_state clean.
  - `Fixes #33581` is right. Every acceptance line is met by this PR or is already on `main`: the `ObjectView` lazy boundary, and the `plugin-form/core` and `plugin-view/core` subpaths (#33677, #34176). The closure measurement covers two builds.
  - The declarations are `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (one new `exports` subpath, `./core`, ESM and types, with nothing removed or renamed) · `Metadata-protocol: none`, so the level is patch.
- **Contract review:** under the declaration leg, an at-tier L2 PASS is owed before the queue. The tier is TIER_DEFAULT: no spec path and no governed path, as for #36181. The card's own acceptance says "contract record owed".
- **Lazy stubs:** `register-plugins.ts` now stubs every tag the two entries register, with the same namespace, `skipFallback` and category as each `ComponentRegistry.register` at this head.
  - `plugin-grid`: `object-grid` and `view:grid`.
  - `plugin-detail`: `detail-view`, `detail-section`, `view:detail`, and the eleven `record:` tags from `details` to `alert`.
  - There is no tag the entries register without a stub, so a schema naming one still loads the package, and the package's own registration replaces the stub.
- **`/core`:** it re-exports 16 pure helpers plus a type, and the root keeps the same names.
  - The ⛔ note forbids a registering module in its closure, and `pluginCoreSubpaths-33581` pins the shell's imports to the subpath.
  - Module-state seeds (`seedRecordVerdict` and its siblings) stay one instance: the console aliases both entries to the one source module, and the published ESM pass (`vite.es.config.ts`, `preserveModules`, two entries in one pass) emits the shared modules once.
  - `exports["./core"]` mirrors `plugin-chatbot`'s `./core` shape. The UMD build is unchanged.
- **Measurements and the browser:**
  - The eager closure goes from 2,042,500 to 1,875,181 B gzip at this head. `plugin-grid` (183,666) leaves and `plugin-detail-core` (15,702) joins. `check:eager-closure` exits 0.
  - In Chromium, five routes draw the same on both builds. Home and dashboard never fetch `plugin-grid`, while the list and record routes fetch it beside their own chunks.
- **Ablations:** `recordPagePayload` returned to the root import turns 3 pins red, and a bare `plugin-grid` import turns the bare-import pin red. Restores were proven against HEAD.
- **File surface:** `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts` (the alias and the `plugin-detail-core` chunk group) and the two `ui/scripts` side-effects tests only deliver the change, so no amendment is owed.
- **Gates:** the scoped test rerun on 58e12ffd08 was NOT MEASURED. It is carried by green CI (Test UI) at this head after a clean `main` merge, which I accept.
- **Landing:** this is not governed. After the L2 PASS, the area lands it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `58e12ffd08ca58760f623cf9043e1fc9c3c4bcbf`
Local-runs: none

Face: the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration (no published schema, no governed path in the 24-file list). Inputs: card #33581 body and all 15 comments, the PR body and file list, the net diff `99fbaa6d..58e12ffd`, and the head's check-runs. The PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no extra author note is owed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **New accept-set entry `exports["./core"]` in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (`types` → `./dist/core.d.ts`, `import` → `./dist/core.js`, no `require`): right.** It is a pure widening with the same shape as the `/core` subpaths of `plugin-form` and `plugin-view`. The changeset declares it as ESM only. A CJS `require` of it fails with `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`, as it does on the precedents.
- **The root entry exports the same names: right.** `src/index.tsx` is byte-unchanged between base and head. Each of the 17 names `src/core.ts` exports is still exported from the root, from the same source module, so the seed caches stay one module in both entries. `normalizeSortSpec` moved verbatim to `relatedListSort.ts`. Its parameter type `RelatedListSortSpec | undefined` is structurally identical to the old `RelatedListProps['defaultSort']`, so the root `normalizeRelatedListSort` signature does not change.
- **`main`, `module`, `types` and the `.` export mapping are unchanged: right.** The UMD pass keeps the same entry, the same externals and `inlineDynamicImports`.
- **Published ESM layout: right.** `vite.es.config.ts` emits `index` and `core` from one pass with `preserveModules`, so `dist/index.js` and `dist/core.js` import the same `dist/queueClaim.js`, `dist/recordFieldAccess.js` and `dist/useRecordEditable.js` files. That is the one-instance answer to option A of the build-shape open question in the #34176 report. The extra per-module files under `dist/` cannot be reached through `exports`, so they are shipped bytes, not accept set. `emptyOutDir: false` keeps the first pass's `.d.ts` files and UMD output. Bare ids are external before alias resolution, as in the main config. There are no CSS imports and no `@/` imports in `src`.
- **The `sideEffects` array is complete under `preserveModules`: right.** I scanned every non-test module in `src` for top-level statements. Load-time effects exist only in `index.tsx` (the 16 `ComponentRegistry.register` calls) and in the three `subscribeDataChanges` subscriptions in `queueClaim.ts`, `recordFieldAccess.tsx` and `useRecordEditable.ts`. All four are listed in both their `src` and `dist` spellings. `core` is added in both spellings, as on the precedents.
- **What `/core` reaches: right.** Its static closure is 14 modules: core, autoLayout, relatedListCompact, relatedListSort, queueClaim, ConcurrentUpdateDialog, useDetailTranslation, recordFieldAccess, useRecordEditable, useRelatedCounts, renderers/recordActivityFeed, and synth/relatedListEntry, relatedArrangement and buildDefaultPageSchema. None of them is `./index`, a renderer, or a module that registers anything. The console's `plugin-detail-core` chunk-group regex names exactly these 14.
- **Console `registerLazy` stubs: right.** There are 16, and each one matches the tag, `namespace`, `skipFallback` and `category` of the registration it stands in for: `object-grid` and `grid` (view, skipFallback) from plugin-grid, then `detail-view`, `detail-section`, `detail` (view) and the eleven `record:` tags (skipFallback) from plugin-detail. Before the first load the stubs carry no `label` or `inputs`. #33677 already accepted that for its lazy stubs.
- **App-shell repoints and `lazyDetailSurfaces.tsx`: right.** Nine modules now take only `/core` names. `HeaderHighlight` and `RelatedList` are drawn through `lazy()` with a type-only import of the entry. `RecordPreviewCard` preloads the chunk beside its record read, and no timeout is raised. The pin `pluginCoreSubpaths-33581.test.ts` covers the new eager modules.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: yes (widening)` appears at the start of a line in both the PR body and the changeset, and it matches the diff: one subpath added, nothing removed or renamed. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right, because no spec or authorable key changes. That makes the level **patch** under AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3, since a non-protocol widening ships as patch. The changeset names `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`, which are the packages the diff changes. `plugin-grid` is untouched and correctly not listed.

Check-runs on the head: 63 in total, 50 success and 13 skipped, none red. `Check Changeset` reran and concluded success. `Test UI 1/16` to `16/16`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Lint UI` and `Lint & Repo Gates` are all success. They answer the dev's unmeasured scoped rerun on this head. `UI Published Artifacts` is skipped because it runs only in the full battery, by ruling: `check:node-esm-load` grades the new `./core` entry and the `preserveModules` root layout first on main's push run, and `scripts/release-publish.sh` blocks on it. The landing seat reads that push run.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open question in the #34176 report (build shape A, B or C for plugin-detail): answered by this diff with A, implemented as one ESM pass with `preserveModules`, and the `sideEffects` treatment holds (①).
- Dev deviations: the edit to console `vite.config.ts` is needed for the chunk group. The two side-effects tests follow the precedent for a third `/core`. Moving `normalizeSortSpec` and the one-line `RecordDetailView` import is neutral. The patch level is right. The premise was partly stale: the `ObjectView` boundary landed in #33677 (card comment 6890062231), and plugin-form and plugin-view landed in #34176. All of these are accepted.
- Dev out-of-scope flag (nothing in the build keeps plugin-grid out of the eager closure): accepted as N2.
- Dev `open_questions` on this report: none.
- SQL push-down: no finding. The diff changes chunk loading only. `preloadDetailEntry` fetches code, not data, and there is no new read, id materialisation or in-app join.

Findings:
- N1 (nit): the docblock in `src/core.ts`, the pin docblock and the comments in `register-plugins.ts` call `/core` "side-effect-free". Its closure runs three `subscribeDataChanges` cache-invalidation listeners when it loads. They were already eager on main, and `sideEffects` declares them correctly. "Registers nothing", the changeset's wording, is the accurate claim.
- N2 (nit; follow-up card): the `plugin-detail-core` chunk regex in console `vite.config.ts` is a hand-kept copy of the `/core` closure. It matches at this head. If a module joins the closure without joining the regex, about 183 KB of plugin-grid returns to every first load, and the eager-closure budget (600 KB headroom) would not catch it. The seat should file the carve-out the dev proposes.
- N3 (nit): in `lazyDetailSurfaces.tsx`, "A failed load is forgotten, so the next draw asks again" is true of `preloadDetailEntry`. It is not true of the two `React.lazy` components, which keep a rejection for the life of the module. A surface recovers on a later mount only if a later preload succeeds, and `SubmittedChildTables` never preloads. Every console `lazy()` behaves this way, so the fix is to the wording.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
